subject: Important Update: Company Policy Changes
body: Dear Team, I hope this email finds you well. I am writing to inform you about some recent changes in our company policies regarding remote work and performance evaluations. These changes are aimed at improving efficiency and ensuring alignment with our long-term goals. Please review the attached document for detailed information. Feel free to reach out if you have any questions or need further clarification. Thank you for your attention to this matter. Best regards, [Your Name]
